rationale: Lisa's deep expertise in AI-XR integration and industrial automation complements Abdul's technical foundation in AI agents and LLM tooling—two capabilities that could power the next generation of enterprise AI systems. Both are San Francisco-based founders building at the intersection of AI infrastructure, and Lisa's go-to-market experience with government and industrial clients pairs well with Abdul's technical depth in solving hard problems in autonomous systems.
intro_message: Lisa Wang, meet Abdul Rahim Mirani — you're both building AI-first technical solutions in San Francisco, and Lisa's enterprise XR and robotics consulting could benefit from Abdul's work on AI agents and LLM tooling for complex, stateful systems.
